title: Cover the session runtime capture target limit at 64 and 65 targets
outcome: A direct unit witness protects SessionRuntimeCapture::start's explicit target-count admission boundary without changing capture semantics.
acceptance: A unit test uses exactly SESSION_RUNTIME_CAPTURE_TARGETS distinct targets and observes successful capture creation, then uses one additional distinct target and observes refusal.
The focused session-runtime capture tests pass on the exact changed input; the change follows the repository's standing review and gate rule.
